def flip(lst, i):
    """Flips the first i+1 elements of lst."""
    start = 0
    while start < i:
        lst[start], lst[i] = lst[i], lst[start]

def pancake_sort(nums):
    """Sorts the given list of numbers using the Pancake Sort algorithm."""
    n = len(nums)
    while n > 1:
        # Find the index of the largest element in nums[0..n-1]
        max_index = nums.index(max(nums[:n]))
        
        # Flip the array from 0 to max_index to move the largest number to its correct position
        flip(nums, max_index)
        
        # Flip the entire array to put the largest number at the end
        flip(nums, n - 1)
        
        # Reduce the size of the unsorted portion
        n -= 1
    
    return nums
